title: Chapter 23 Snowstorm Night
content:
Chapter 23 Snowstorm Night

Wang Shuo opened the [Chat Channel].

"It's not over yet. We just experienced acid rain, and now there's a snowstorm. They don't treat us as human beings!"

“I’m going to die, I’m going to die, but I don’t know if my wooden house can bear it?”

"I estimate that the main reason is the temperature. It will definitely drop to many degrees below zero."

"I don't even have a quilt now. Please give me cotton clothes and quilts."

Wang Shuo felt that the time had come for him to make a fortune, no, to help his compatriots.

He reacted immediately and opened the trading shop directly without getting anything to eat.

Sweeping a lot of cotton.

Many players have not yet changed their prices.

There were 1 cotton for 2 wood, and 10 cotton for 1 silver coin. Wang Shuo bought them all with a unit price of less than 20 copper coins.

A total of 20 wood, 100 stone, 200L water and 2 gold coins were used in exchange for 2400 units of cotton.

At this stage, cotton is either obtained by players opening treasure chests or discovering cotton fields, so the price depends entirely on the players themselves, and there is no standardized market price yet.

Wang Shuo laughed when he saw the 2,700 units of cotton in his hand.

Wang Shuo, who was in a happy mood, went directly to Chef Zhang and ordered a takeaway.

Then we started making cotton-padded clothes and a six-piece bed set.

[Six-piece bedding set: 10 cotton + 2 cotton cloth + 2 cotton thread]

[Cotton clothing (cotton clothing + cotton pants): cotton 4 + cotton cloth 1 + cotton thread 1]

Just when Wang Shuo made 10 sets of cotton clothes and 10 sets of bedding.

The tool table and forging table upgrades are complete.

Wang Shuo opened the tool table and found that it could increase the production speed. It was like dozing off on a pillow!

[Level 2 Tool Bench: Intermediate items can be made. Please explore the specific "synthetic formula" by yourself. 】

[Level 2 forging platform: You can create ordinary armor, unlock more weapon production, and unlock sophisticated level weapons. Please explore the specific "synthetic formula" by yourself. 】

Ignoring other things for now, he just wants to make cotton clothes and six-piece suits.

At the beginning, it took one minute to make a set of cotton clothes, but now it only takes 30 seconds.

However, the production speed can’t keep up!

With 2,700 units of cotton, he plans to make 150 sets of cotton suits and six-piece suits, leaving 100 units of cotton in reserve.

This would take more than an hour. I don't know if these players can wait. He found the construction acceleration scroll in the warehouse, but there was no way to speed up the production of items.

In desperation, he had to make some and put some in the trading house.

He glanced at other people's prices first. The most exaggerated one was directly priced at 100 gold coins.

More are between 1 gold coin and 3 gold coins.

The price of cotton is now as low as 5 silver coins per unit.

The prices are just crazy.

Under the threat of death, a bottle of water may be sold for 500 yuan.

Wang Shuo priced each cotton-padded jacket at 80 silver coins, which is not excessive!

Each six-piece bedding set costs 2 gold coins, but it’s not excessive!

This can not only quickly withdraw funds, but also help some compatriots.

And even at this price, he can only produce 150 sets, which can only meet the needs of a small number of people. This blizzard is destined to take away many people.

Open [Chat Channel].

"100 gold coins, a set of cotton clothes, you are going crazy thinking about money!"

"Fuck, it's so damn expensive, why don't you just die!"

"It's too expensive upstairs, so don't buy it!"

"Thank God, someone finally lowered the price. I bought a set of cotton clothes for 80 silver coins!"

"I can't afford it for 80 silver. Please lower the price."

…

After a while, Wang Shuo discovered that a man named Zhao Tianze kept buying his cotton clothes, and then listed them in the trading house at several times the price.

Wang Shuo was a little angry. This kind of person was simply crazy.

Wang Shuo changed the trading house's purchase requirements to limit the purchase of one set per person.

Soon, Zhao Tianze sent a private message to Wang Shuo.

"Boy, what do you mean, why don't you sell it to me?"

"I can sell the things I make however I want. Do you have any control over it?"

"Don't you think your behavior of buying low and selling high is a bit excessive at this time?"

"You are selling something and I am buying something, but you are short of money? I warn you, don't block my way to make a fortune. I will take whatever goods you have, otherwise..." Zhao Tianze threatened.

"You can still come along the trading house and hit me!" Wang Shuo said with some disdain.

"Your name is Wang Shuo, right? I remember you." Zhao Tianze said viciously.

Wang Shuo no longer wants to pay attention to such people. As long as he is strong, there is nothing to fear in the face of such threats.

Wang Shuo checked the backpack again and found that there were still many things that could be made. However, the tool bench was always occupied, so he had to turn his attention to the forging bench.

After upgrading the level 2 forging bench, he can make more weapons and armor.

Before, he could only make leather armor and some basic weapons, but now he can make iron armor.

He also has a lot of iron, coal, and bronze ore, and can make some weapons and bronze keys.

These things should also be of great use to players who have treasure chests and urgently need to deal with the beasts in their territory.

"This is called market analysis." Wang Shuo couldn't help but praise himself, "When did I start to have such a business acumen?"

In the following time, he used the forging table to make 490 bronze keys. Since bronze keys consume very little bronze ore, he still has 300 bronze ores.

Wang Shuo guessed that all the bronze ores at present should be obtained from treasure chests. There are very few players with bronze ores, and he should be the only one who can make bronze keys. He just went to the trading house to search, but there were no bronze keys for sale.

"Monopoly business!" Wang Shuo was a little proud.

He forged all the 800 iron ores he got into iron ingots, and then made some weapons and armor.

[Pukao: 1 hemp rope + 1 iron ingot]

[Long spear: 1 wooden stick + 1 iron ingot]

[Iron armor: 2 iron ingots]

[Wooden bow: 1 wooden stick + 1 hemp rope]

[10 (iron) arrows = 1 wooden stick + 10 arrowheads + 1 feather]

Still left 21 iron ingots for backup, and made all the others.

He didn't make sophisticated weapons, mainly because he was afraid that players couldn't afford them, and the cost of materials was too high, so ordinary weapons were the most suitable.

"What price should the weapons be set at?" Wang Shuo was entangled, but the smile on his face showed that he was secretly happy.

[Puko +15, Long Lance +15, Iron Armor +10, Wooden Bow +20, Iron Arrow +1000]

What was worthy of Wang Shuo's surprise was that there was actually a bow and arrow of excellent quality, and good things naturally had to be kept for himself.

Looking at these high-end goods in the warehouse, Wang Shuo was very uneasy.

Opening the trading house, the Pudao was priced at 1 gold coin, the long spear was 1.5 gold coins, the wooden bow was 2 gold and 50 silver (with 10 iron arrows), and the rest of the iron arrows, 2 silver and 10, were all hung up.

Bronze keys were directly 2 gold coins each, and 100 were hung up.

Who knows what good things others can open.

2 gold coins, but drizzle.

He still has more than 10,000 tiles, and he also put up 15,000 tiles at the price of 10 silver coins for 100 tiles.

There are also bedding, cotton clothes...

It was already late at night when he finished all this.

Wang Shuo's eyelids were a little droopy, and he fell asleep directly.

...

Tang Hua, a player who opened a treasure chest and got a flint at the beginning, took advantage of the early advantages, and quickly stood his ground. He has also upgraded to a stone house, but the acid rain drained all his savings, and now he has finally recovered.

Because he has tasted the sweetness of trading, the most thing he does every day is to visit the trading house.

At this moment, he suddenly found that a large number of weapons appeared in the trading house. The number was huge, and it was impossible to get them from opening a treasure chest, and the price made him a little breathless.

Now all the money on his body, added together, is less than one gold coin.

He clicked it and his eyes widened immediately.

Because each weapon has a number.

"Could it be that a player has become a blacksmith, or has found a blacksmith? This is simply taking off!"

He directly clicked on the player's information and checked all his consignment items.

For a moment, he stood there in a daze, not saying a word for a long time.

"This big guy is too scary!"
